name: banu arjunan
text: Hi, this is Banupriya from Chennai Porur. I had a problem on the left side at the back of my head. I suddenly noticed a swelling about 4 cm in size there. Pain started, so I went to the hospital, where they gave me an injection and medicines. The pain was mildly suppressed, but the swelling didn't reduce. Later, I got a fever of 101°C. I went back to the same hospital, and they gave me another injection. The pain completely went away, but the swelling size remained the same. The doctor advised a CT scan, which showed what looked like Cancer Katti or TB katti. He recommended a biopsy to confirm and said I'd need to take medicine for a year if confirmed.We panicked and didn't go back. Then my mom suggested acupuncture, saying it was the best option. I wasn't convinced and didn't believe in it, but my parents compelled me to try it. To my surprise, the swelling started reducing! Now I'm very happy, the swelling has gone down significantly, and I strongly trust acupuncture. I even suggest it to my friends and relatives.Thanks to Dr. Basheer Basha for this acupuncture treatment. You brought my life back and put a smile on my face!
